defs:
def sdl: [.assets | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("schemas/")) | .value] | join("
"); def fields($type): sdl | [capture("type " + $type + "(\s[^{]*)?\{(?<b>[^}]*)\}").b | split("
")[] | select(test("^\s*[a-z_]+:")) ]; def names($type): fields($type) | map(capture("^\s*(?<n>[a-z_]+):").n); def header($type): sdl | capture("(?<h>type " + $type + "(\s[^{]*)?)\{").h; def entries: (.entries | if type == "object" then .entries else . end); def gate: .config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-gate"); def surface_of($id): .config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == $id) | entries; def surface: surface_of("claim-graph-writes"); def entry($t): surface[] | select(.tool_name == $t); def entry_of($s; $t): surface_of($s)[] | select(.tool_name == $t); def required: [.fields[] | select(.required == true) | .name] | sort; def names_of: [.fields[].name] | sort; def fill($n): (.fields[] | select(.name == $n) | .fill); def profile: .assets["profiles/research.json"] | fromjson; def general: .assets["profiles/general.json"] | fromjson; def tools($id): .config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == $id); def card($prompt; $t): .assets[$prompt] | split("
") | map(select(startswith("- `" + $t + "` ("))) | if length == 1 then .[0] | [scan("`([a-z_]+)`")[0]] else null end; def card_collections($prompt): .assets[$prompt] | [scan("(?m)^- `([A-Z][A-Za-z]+)` \(")[0]]; def fences($prompt): .assets[$prompt] | split("
") | map(select(startswith("{"batch_id":"")) | fromjson); def lines($text): ($text // "") | split("
") | map(select(length > 0) | fromjson); def all_collections: ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph", "ClaimBatch", "GateReceipt", "ExportRequest", "ExportReceipt", "ViewRequest", "ViewReceipt", "Source", "SourceRequest", "ResearchRequest", "ResearchReceipt"]; def prompts: ["agent_behaviors/claim_sme/system_prompt.md", "agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md", "agent_behaviors/claim_reviewer/system_prompt.md"]; def claim_keys: ["id", "text", "quote", "from", "sources", "entities", "kind", "by", "asserted", "status", "confidence", "note"];

jq.name: every scalar schema field is immutable (DefraDB refuses @immutable on a list)
jq.expr: . as $d | all_collections | all(. as $t | ($d | fields($t)) as $f | ($f | length) > 0 and ($f | all(test(": \\[") or test("@immutable")))) and ([$d | fields("Claim"), fields("Entity"), fields("ClaimGraph") | map(select(test(": \\["))) | length] == [1, 1, 7])

jq.name: the manifest declares exactly the fifteen schema files
jq.expr: .manifest.schemas | sort == ["schemas/claim.graphql", "schemas/claim_batch.graphql", "schemas/claim_graph.graphql", "schemas/edge.graphql", "schemas/entity.graphql", "schemas/export_receipt.graphql", "schemas/export_request.graphql", "schemas/gate_receipt.graphql", "schemas/perspective.graphql", "schemas/research_receipt.graphql", "schemas/research_request.graphql", "schemas/source.graphql", "schemas/source_request.graphql", "schemas/view_receipt.graphql", "schemas/view_request.graphql"]

jq.name: every schema carries an indexed immutable graph_id
jq.expr: . as $d | all_collections | all(. as $t | $d | fields($t) | any(test("^\\s*graph_id: String @index @immutable$")))

jq.name: graph rows, sources and profile versions are unique per graph, not globally
jq.expr: . as $d | [["Claim", "claim_id"], ["Edge", "edge_key"], ["Entity", "entity_id"], ["Perspective", "perspective_id"], ["ClaimGraph", "version"], ["Source", "source_id"]] | all(. as [$t, $k] | ($d | header($t) | contains("@index(fields: [\"graph_id\", \"" + $k + "\"], unique: true)")) and ($d | fields($t) | map(select(test("^\\s*" + $k + ":"))) | length == 1 and all(test("unique") | not)))

jq.name: the source, research request and research receipt shapes are the 0.3.0 contract
jq.expr: . as $d | ($d | names("Source")) == ["source_id", "graph_id", "request_id", "url", "final_url", "title", "fetched_at", "status", "error", "http_status", "content_type", "content_hash", "text", "text_chars", "truncated", "confidential", "note"] and ($d | names("SourceRequest")) == ["request_id", "graph_id", "url", "confidential", "note", "submitted_at"] and ($d | names("ResearchRequest")) == ["request_id", "graph_id", "topic", "brief", "max_sources", "create_graph", "note", "submitted_at"] and ($d | names("ResearchReceipt")) == ["receipt_id", "request_id", "graph_id", "summary", "sources_fetched", "sources_failed", "batches_filed", "claims_admitted", "claims_memory", "open_questions", "finished_at"] and ([$d | header("SourceRequest", "ResearchRequest", "ResearchReceipt") | test("@index")] == [false, false, false]) and ([$d | fields("SourceRequest", "ResearchRequest") | .[0]] | all(test("request_id: String @index\\(unique: true\\) @immutable"))) and ($d | fields("ResearchReceipt") | .[0] | test("receipt_id: String @index\\(unique: true\\) @immutable"))

jq.name: the gate callback emits one receipt, four row ports and the profile port, correlated by batch_id
jq.expr: gate | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_gate", "gents/claim_gate")) and .correlation_field == "batch_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required: (.required // false)}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "GateReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true}, {name: "claims", collection: "Claim", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "edges", collection: "Edge", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "entities", collection: "Entity", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "perspectives", collection: "Perspective", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "profile", collection: "ClaimGraph", cardinality: "one", required: false}]) and (.outputs | all(.correlation_field == "batch_id" and .schema == (.collection + "/v1")))

jq.name: every gate output collection has a schema with a batch_id field
jq.expr: . as $d | gate | .handler.outputs | all(.collection as $c | $d | fields($c) | any(test("^\\s*batch_id:")))

jq.name: the gate fires on created ClaimBatch documents and is bound to every ClaimBatch field
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "claim-batch") | .source_collection == "ClaimBatch" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "batch_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-gate") | .event_source_id == "claim-batch" and (.input_fields | sort) == ($d | names("ClaimBatch") | sort))

jq.name: a SourceRequest runs claim_sources with one required Source port, bound to the five request fields
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-sources") | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_sources", "gents/claim_sources")) and .correlation_field == "request_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required, correlation_field, schema}) == [{name: "source", collection: "Source", cardinality: "one", required: true, correlation_field: "request_id", schema: "Source/v1"}])) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "source-request") | .source_collection == "SourceRequest" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "request_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-sources") | .callback_id == "claim-sources" and .event_source_id == "source-request" and .input_fields == ["request_id", "graph_id", "url", "confidential", "note"]) and ($d | names("Source") | index("request_id") != null)

jq.name: the plugins query only what they read; claim_sources reads only Source
jq.expr: [.manifest.plugins[] | {key: .name, value: .data}] | from_entries == {claim_gate: {collections: ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph", "Source"], ops: ["query"]}, claim_export: {collections: ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph", "Source"], ops: ["query"]}, claim_views: {collections: ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph"], ops: ["query"]}, claim_sources: {collections: ["Source"], ops: ["query"]}}

jq.name: the gate reads source_root; export and views write out_dir; claim_sources binds no folder
jq.expr: .manifest.plugins | (map(select(.name == "claim_gate"))[0].bind_dir | .input_field == "source_root" and .access == "read") and (map(select(.name == "claim_export" or .name == "claim_views")) | length == 2 and all(.bind_dir | .input_field == "out_dir" and .access == "read_write" and .original_field == "out_dir_original")) and (map(select(.name == "claim_sources"))[0] | has("bind_dir") | not)

jq.name: claim_sources asks for unscoped outbound HTTP and nothing else, within its limits
jq.expr: . as $d | $d.manifest.plugins | map(select(.name == "claim_sources"))[0] | .manifold == {net: {OutboundHttp: null}, fs: "None", env: "None", child_process: false, crypto: false, http_timeout_ms: 8000} and .limits == {memory_mib: 128, wall_clock_secs: 60, max_output_mib: 4} and .language == "rust" and .artifact == "plugins/claim_sources.afb" and .source == "plugins/claim_sources" and .instructions == "plugins/claim_sources/TOOL.md" and (.input_schema.properties | keys | sort) == ["confidential", "graph_id", "note", "request_id", "url"] and (.input_schema.required | sort) == ["graph_id", "request_id", "url"] and ([$d.manifest.plugins[] | select(.name != "claim_sources") | has("manifold")] | all(not))

jq.name: every plugin input names the graph, and a view is one of the three
jq.expr: .manifest.plugins | all(.input_schema.properties.graph_id.type == "string") and (map(select(.name == "claim_views"))[0].input_schema | .properties.view.enum == ["status", "disputes", "reputation"] and (.required | sort) == ["graph_id", "request_id", "view"] and (.properties | keys | sort) == ["dry_run", "graph_id", "out_dir", "out_dir_original", "request_id", "view"])

jq.name: the SME queries the graph, sources, profiles and receipts, writes only through its surface, and may export
jq.expr: tools("claim-sme-tools") | .datastore.enable_defra_query == true and (.datastore.defra_query_collections | sort) == ["Claim", "ClaimGraph", "Edge", "Entity", "ExportReceipt", "GateReceipt", "Perspective", "ResearchReceipt", "Source", "ViewReceipt"] and .datastore.datastore_tool_surface_ids == ["claim-graph-writes"] and (.datastore.write_collections // [] | length == 0) and (.integrations.plugins | map(.plugin)) == ["gents/claim_export"]

jq.name: the researcher and reviewer query their collections and write only through their surfaces, with no plugins
jq.expr: (tools("claim-researcher-tools") | (.datastore.defra_query_collections | sort) == ["Claim", "ClaimGraph", "Edge", "Entity", "GateReceipt", "Perspective", "ResearchRequest", "Source"] and .datastore.datastore_tool_surface_ids == ["claim-researcher-writes"]) and (tools("claim-reviewer-tools") | (.datastore.defra_query_collections | sort) == ["Claim", "ClaimGraph", "Edge", "Entity", "GateReceipt", "Perspective", "ResearchReceipt", "Source", "ViewReceipt"] and .datastore.datastore_tool_surface_ids == ["claim-reviewer-writes"]) and ([tools("claim-researcher-tools", "claim-reviewer-tools") | .datastore.enable_defra_query == true and (.datastore.write_collections // [] | length == 0) and (.integrations.plugins // [] | length == 0)] | all)

jq.name: file_claims creates a ClaimBatch for one graph with optional edges and no source_root or profile
jq.expr: ([surface[].tool_name] | sort) == ["file_claims", "request_view", "start_research"] and (entry("file_claims") | .collection == "ClaimBatch" and required == ["batch_id", "claims", "graph_id", "section"] and ([.fields[].name] | index("edges") != null and index("source_root") == null and index("profile") == null and index("entities") == null and index("perspectives") == null))

jq.name: start_research creates a ResearchRequest with the graph and topic the SME supplies, and nothing the researcher decides
jq.expr: entry("start_research") | .collection == "ResearchRequest" and required == ["graph_id", "request_id", "topic"] and names_of == ["brief", "graph_id", "note", "request_id", "topic"] and ([.fields[] | .fill] | all(. == null))

jq.name: request_view creates a ViewRequest for one graph without a folder
jq.expr: entry("request_view") | .collection == "ViewRequest" and required == ["graph_id", "request_id", "view"] and ([.fields[].name] | index("out_dir") == null)

jq.name: the researcher surface starts a graph with profile, entities and perspectives, fetches sources and finishes, every graph and request id supplied by the model (no fills, so a direct chat works)
jq.expr: ([surface_of("claim-researcher-writes")[].tool_name] | sort) == ["fetch_source", "file_batch", "finish_research", "start_graph"] and (entry_of("claim-researcher-writes"; "start_graph") | .collection == "ClaimBatch" and required == ["batch_id", "entities", "graph_id", "perspectives", "profile", "section"] and names_of == ["batch_id", "claims", "edges", "entities", "graph_id", "note", "perspectives", "profile", "section"]) and (entry_of("claim-researcher-writes"; "file_batch") | .collection == "ClaimBatch" and required == ["batch_id", "claims", "graph_id", "section"] and names_of == ["batch_id", "claims", "edges", "entities", "extractor", "graph_id", "note", "perspectives", "section"]) and (entry_of("claim-researcher-writes"; "fetch_source") | .collection == "SourceRequest" and required == ["graph_id", "request_id", "url"] and names_of == ["confidential", "graph_id", "note", "request_id", "url"]) and (entry_of("claim-researcher-writes"; "finish_research") | .collection == "ResearchReceipt" and required == ["batches_filed", "claims_admitted", "claims_memory", "graph_id", "receipt_id", "request_id", "sources_failed", "sources_fetched", "summary"]) and ([surface_of("claim-researcher-writes", "claim-reviewer-writes")[] | .fields[] | .fill] | all(. == null))

jq.name: the reviewer files batches and requests views for a graph it names, with no fills
jq.expr: ([surface_of("claim-reviewer-writes")[].tool_name] | sort) == ["file_batch", "request_view"] and (entry_of("claim-reviewer-writes"; "file_batch") | .collection == "ClaimBatch" and required == ["batch_id", "claims", "graph_id", "section"] and names_of == ["batch_id", "claims", "edges", "extractor", "graph_id", "note", "perspectives", "section"]) and (entry_of("claim-reviewer-writes"; "request_view") | .collection == "ViewRequest" and required == ["graph_id", "request_id", "view"])

jq.name: no surface lets an agent set source_root or out_dir
jq.expr: [.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | entries[] | .fields[].name] | (index("source_root") == null and index("out_dir") == null)

jq.name: every surface field names a field of its collection
jq.expr: . as $d | [.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | entries[] | .collection as $c | ($d | names($c)) as $n | .fields | all(.name as $f | $n | index($f) != null)] | all

jq.name: the three agents use their own slots and contexts
jq.expr: (.config.agents | map({agent_id, context_id, inference_profile_id}) | sort_by(.agent_id)) == [{agent_id: "claim-researcher", context_id: "claim-researcher-context", inference_profile_id: "gents:inference-slot:researcher"}, {agent_id: "claim-reviewer", context_id: "claim-reviewer-context", inference_profile_id: "gents:inference-slot:reviewer"}, {agent_id: "claim-sme", context_id: "claim-sme-context", inference_profile_id: "gents:inference-slot:sme"}] and (.manifest.inference_slots | map({name, agents}) | sort_by(.name)) == [{name: "researcher", agents: ["claim-researcher"]}, {name: "reviewer", agents: ["claim-reviewer"]}, {name: "sme", agents: ["claim-sme"]}] and ([.config.contexts[] | {context_id, tools_id}] | sort_by(.context_id)) == [{context_id: "claim-researcher-context", tools_id: "claim-researcher-tools"}, {context_id: "claim-reviewer-context", tools_id: "claim-reviewer-tools"}, {context_id: "claim-sme-context", tools_id: "claim-sme-tools"}]

jq.name: a ResearchRequest runs the researcher and its ResearchReceipt runs the reviewer, serially, correlated by request_id
jq.expr: . as $d | ([.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id | IN("research-request", "research-receipt")) | {event_source_id, source_collection, event_kind, correlation_field}] | sort_by(.event_source_id)) == [{event_source_id: "research-receipt", source_collection: "ResearchReceipt", event_kind: "created", correlation_field: "request_id"}, {event_source_id: "research-request", source_collection: "ResearchRequest", event_kind: "created", correlation_field: "request_id"}] and ([.config.triggers[] | {trigger_id, concurrency, source: .source.event_source_id, task_id}] | sort_by(.trigger_id)) == [{trigger_id: "research-receipt", concurrency: "serial", source: "research-receipt", task_id: "claim-review-task"}, {trigger_id: "research-request", concurrency: "serial", source: "research-request", task_id: "claim-research-task"}] and ([.config.tasks[] | {task_id, agent_id}] | sort_by(.task_id)) == [{task_id: "claim-research-task", agent_id: "claim-researcher"}, {task_id: "claim-review-task", agent_id: "claim-reviewer"}]

jq.name: the task prompts carry the request and receipt fields
jq.expr: (.assets["tasks/claim_research_task/prompt.md"] as $p | ["doc.topic", "doc.brief", "doc.graph_id", "doc.max_sources", "doc.create_graph", "doc.request_id", "ctx.now"] | all(. as $w | $p | contains("{{ " + $w))) and (.assets["tasks/claim_review_task/prompt.md"] as $p | ["doc.request_id", "doc.graph_id", "doc.receipt_id", "doc.summary", "doc.open_questions", "ctx.now"] | all(. as $w | $p | contains("{{ " + $w)))

jq.name: each prompt opens with a schema card naming every field of each collection it describes
jq.expr: . as $d | [["agent_behaviors/claim_sme/system_prompt.md", ["ClaimGraph", "Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "Source", "ClaimBatch", "GateReceipt", "ViewRequest", "ViewReceipt", "ResearchRequest", "ResearchReceipt", "ExportReceipt"]], ["agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md", ["ResearchRequest", "ClaimGraph", "SourceRequest", "Source", "ClaimBatch", "GateReceipt", "Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ResearchReceipt"]], ["agent_behaviors/claim_reviewer/system_prompt.md", ["ResearchReceipt", "ClaimGraph", "Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "Source", "ClaimBatch", "GateReceipt", "ViewRequest", "ViewReceipt"]]] | all(. as [$p, $cs] | ($d.assets[$p] | split("\n## ")[1] | startswith("Schema card")) and ($d | card_collections($p)) == $cs and ($cs | all(. as $t | ($d | card($p; $t)) == ($d | names($t)))))

jq.name: the researcher's worked batches parse: the general profile verbatim, three perspectives, entities, two sourced claims and an edge in key order
jq.expr: . as $d | fences("agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md") as $f | ($f | length) == 2 and ($f[0] | (.profile | fromjson) == ($d | general) and (lines(.perspectives) | map(.id)) == ["p:owner", "p:researcher", "p:reviewer"] and (lines(.entities) | map(.id) | index("e:open-question") != null) and .graph_id == "rosetta") and ($f[1] | (lines(.claims) | length == 2 and all((keys_unsorted == claim_keys) and .confidence == "sourced" and (.from | startswith("source:")) and .sources[0].source == (.from | ltrimstr("source:") | split("#")[0]) and (.text | split(" ") | length) <= 40)) and (lines(.edges) | length == 1 and all(keys_unsorted == ["from", "to", "type", "by", "date", "note"])) and (lines(.entities) | all(keys_unsorted == ["id", "type", "name", "aliases", "note"])) and .graph_id == "rosetta")

jq.name: the reviewer's worked batch parses: a review with its verdict and a challenge, each with its one edge
jq.expr: fences("agent_behaviors/claim_reviewer/system_prompt.md") as $f | ($f | length) == 1 and ($f[0] | (lines(.claims) | map(.kind) == ["review", "challenge"] and all(.quote == .text and .confidence == "inferred" and (.from | startswith("review:")))) and (lines(.claims)[0] | keys_unsorted == claim_keys + ["verdict"] and .verdict == "sustains") and (lines(.edges) | map(.type) == ["reviews", "challenges"]) and .graph_id == "rosetta")

jq.name: the prompts teach the receipt loop, the refile suffix and the gate's memory and source errors
jq.expr: . as $d | prompts | all(. as $p | $d.assets[$p] | contains("GateReceipt") and contains("-r2") and contains("is from memory but claims confidence <c>")) and ($d.assets["agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md"] | ["quote not found verbatim in source <source_id>", "cites source <source_id> which is missing or failed", "from names no source id (write source:<source_id>#<anchor>)", "is sourced but cites no fetched doc, code ref or source", "is from memory but its quote is not its text", "never invent a `source_id`", "fetch_source", "field_page", "finish_research"] | all(. as $w | $d.assets["agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md"] | ascii_downcase | contains($w | ascii_downcase))) and ([prompts[] as $p | $d.assets[$p] | contains("cites no fetched doc or code ref")] | any | not)

jq.name: the researcher and reviewer prompts say which ids to use in a triggered run and in a direct chat, and the researcher never creates a ResearchRequest
jq.expr: . as $d | ["agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md", "agent_behaviors/claim_reviewer/system_prompt.md"] | all(. as $p | $d.assets[$p] | contains("In a triggered run, use exactly the `graph_id` and `request_id` your task message gives.") and contains("In a direct chat") and contains("chat-<graph_id>-")) and ($d.assets["agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md"] | contains("do not create a `ResearchRequest`") and contains("still finish with `finish_research`"))

jq.name: the SME prompt names the tools, the graph scope and the status rule's edge types
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/claim_sme/system_prompt.md"] as $d0 | ($d0 | contains("file_question") | not) and (["file_claims", "request_view", "ClaimGraph", "graph_id", "retracts", "supersedes", "contradicts", "challenges", "answers", "resolves", "reviews", "challenged", "entity_text", "ViewReceipt", "source:", "memory:", "start_research", "ResearchReceipt", "new slug"] | all(. as $w | $d0 | contains($w)))

jq.name: the research profile holds exactly the profile fields and the dispute vocabulary
jq.expr: . as $d | profile | (keys | sort) == ($d | names("ClaimGraph") - ["graph_id", "version", "batch_id", "created_at"] | sort) and (["question", "challenge", "review"] - .kinds == []) and (["answers", "challenges", "reviews", "resolves", "supersedes", "retracts", "contradicts"] - .edge_types == []) and .review_verdicts == ["sustains", "weakens", "unclear"] and .resolver_perspectives == ["p:mike"] and .mapping_targets == ["defradb", "fefra"] and .question_entity == "e:open-question" and .questions_from_prefix == "graph/claims/questions.jsonl" and .claim_id_pattern == "^c:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{3}$" and .text_max_words == 40 and ([.kinds, .confidence_classes, .edge_types, .mapping_targets, .mapping_fits, .review_verdicts] | all(length > 0 and (unique | length) == length))

jq.name: the general profile has no mapping vocabulary, the dispute vocabulary, the owner as resolver and questions from memory
jq.expr: . as $d | general | (keys | sort) == ($d | names("ClaimGraph") - ["graph_id", "version", "batch_id", "created_at"] | sort) and .kinds == ["fact", "number", "date", "rule", "interpretation", "position", "quote", "question", "challenge", "review"] and .confidence_classes == ["sourced", "memory", "inferred"] and (.edge_types | length == 11 and (unique | length) == 11) and (["answers", "challenges", "reviews", "resolves", "supersedes", "retracts", "contradicts"] - .edge_types == []) and ($d | profile | .edge_types | sort) == (.edge_types | sort) and .mapping_targets == [] and .mapping_fits == [] and .review_verdicts == ["sustains", "weakens", "unclear"] and .resolver_perspectives == ["p:owner"] and .question_entity == "e:open-question" and .default_asker == "p:owner" and .questions_from_prefix == "memory:questions" and .claim_id_pattern == "^c:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{3}$" and .text_max_words == 40

jq.name: the import tool, prompts, task prompts and README carry no em or en dash
jq.expr: [.assets["README.md"], .assets["tools/import_jsonl.sh"], .assets["tasks/claim_research_task/prompt.md"], .assets["tasks/claim_review_task/prompt.md"], (prompts[] as $p | .assets[$p])] | all(test("—|–") | not)

jq.name: an ExportRequest runs claim_export as a callback with one required ExportReceipt port, and may ask for source text
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-export") | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_export", "gents/claim_export")) and .correlation_field == "request_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required, correlation_field}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "ExportReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true, correlation_field: "request_id"}])) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "export-request") | .source_collection == "ExportRequest" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "request_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-export") | .callback_id == "claim-export" and .event_source_id == "export-request" and .input_fields == ["request_id", "graph_id", "out_dir", "sections", "dry_run", "include_source_text"]) and ($d | names("ExportReceipt") | index("request_id") != null) and ($d | names("ExportRequest") | index("include_source_text") != null) and ($d.manifest.plugins[] | select(.name == "claim_export") | .input_schema.properties.include_source_text.type == "boolean")

jq.name: a ViewRequest runs claim_views as a callback with one required ViewReceipt port
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-views") | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_views", "gents/claim_views")) and .correlation_field == "request_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required, correlation_field, schema}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "ViewReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true, correlation_field: "request_id", schema: "ViewReceipt/v1"}])) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "view-request") | .source_collection == "ViewRequest" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "request_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-views") | .callback_id == "claim-views" and .event_source_id == "view-request" and .input_fields == ["request_id", "graph_id", "view", "out_dir", "dry_run"]) and ($d | names("ViewReceipt") | index("request_id") != null) and ($d | names("ViewRequest") | sort) == (["request_id", "graph_id", "view", "out_dir", "dry_run", "note", "submitted_at"] | sort)

jq.name: the manifest is version 0.3.0 and declares the new prompts, profile and plugin files
jq.expr: .manifest.version == "0.3.0" and (["agent_behaviors/claim_researcher/system_prompt.md", "agent_behaviors/claim_reviewer/system_prompt.md", "tasks/claim_research_task/prompt.md", "tasks/claim_review_task/prompt.md", "profiles/general.json", "plugins/claim_sources.afb", "plugins/claim_sources/TOOL.md"] - .manifest.assets == [])
